recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source fix that completes the Applied Jira resolution and preserves the intended boundary that non-family/non-household collections acting as questionnaire actors use Organization rather than Group.
issue_request: FHIR-41407 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers change request asking that QuestionnaireResponse support family or household Groups as both author and source. The accepted resolution was to add Group as an allowed author and source, with comments on both indicating that the referenced Group SHALL contain only Patient and/or RelatedPerson members and that other collections of people must use Organization.
initial_application: Git commit ecc9102e069e6363c7341ca65018009c84ba4eab was the Jira-tagged application and changed only QuestionnaireResponse.author. Current source already included Group and a limiting comment for author, but QuestionnaireResponse.source still lacked Group and the required limiting comment.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-41674 is the related Group-versus-Organization boundary issue cited by FHIR-41407 comments and supports the same bounded interpretation, while Confluence SDC minutes record discussion and disposition. No relevant Zulip conflict was found.
reconciliation: Changed the current build-scope QuestionnaireResponse StructureDefinition to add Group as a targetProfile for QuestionnaireResponse.source, add the source-side comment limiting Group use to family, household, or similar units whose members SHALL be Patient and/or RelatedPerson, and align the existing author comment with the same SHALL-member wording.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: tightened QuestionnaireResponse.author comment to state Group members SHALL be limited to Patient and/or RelatedPerson.
source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: added the matching bounded Group comment to QuestionnaireResponse.source.
